column1: # Expected values produced by the official SQuAD v1.1 evaluation
# script (ADR-C30 § 1). Frozen CI regression fixture — see
# regenerate_squad_parity.py, and do not edit a value by hand.
# exact_match <TAB> token_f1 <TAB> normalised answer <TAB> answer <TAB> reference [<TAB> reference ...]
# exact_match and token_f1 are metric_max_over_ground_truths over
# every reference; the normalised answer is normalize_answer(answer).
# Fields are escaped: `\\` is a backslash, `\u{hex}` any
# non-printable character or a space at either end of a field.
# a typographic dash is not a hyphen
# an is an article, and is not
# final capital sigma against medial form
# article glued to an accented word
# exact match from one reference, F1 from another
# F1 maximum not on the exact-match reference
# empty prediction against an article-only reference
# empty-normalising reference beside a real one
# dotted capital I lowers to two characters
# digits make an article part of a word
# repeated tokens count as a multiset
